mode: new ui mockups with visual references
common:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE NEW finished high-end in-game UI concept screenshot for LORE, landscape 16:9. Reference images 1 and 2 are STRONG ART DIRECTION references, not edit targets. Translate their setting into a PLAYABLE GAME SCREEN. Do not repeat their cinematic camera, seated full-body composition or logo. Match their beautiful polished anime fantasy rendering, luminous white/blue marble, deep midnight-blue Biblion shelves in the periphery, fine restrained gold, cobalt crystal light, warm neutral faces, red/cobalt cloth. This must feel like a premium Japanese card game inside this exact room, not gothic necromancy, sepia parchment, generic dashboard, mobile HUD, or mechanical steampunk. Thin frames; rich depth INSIDE the cards. Bright legible play surface, dark blue peripheral architecture. No ornamental overload.

FIXED COMPOSITION, highest priority: OPPONENT red Seeker portrait at absolute TOP CENTER x50%, your blue Seeker portrait at absolute BOTTOM CENTER x50%. Never move portraits to left/right corners. Red Seeker = the reference blonde/silver ponytail girl with red ribbon/cape, amber eyes. Blue Seeker = reference blue-haired golden-eyed young man in cobalt jacket, white shoulder, dark high collar. Portraits are compact circular or arched bust cameos, not bodies obstructing field. Both cards/fields lie between them.
Readable layered layout approximate y-coordinates: enemy portrait y7%; enemy spell/trap backrow y18%; enemy 3 monsters y28%; shared markets y46–55%; your 3 monsters y65%; your spell/trap row y75%; your portrait y84%; your 5-card hand y94%, bottom edge okay only if all five art+costs identifiable. All cards upright towards viewer. No tilted fighting lanes.

MARKETS EXACT COUNT: at screen spatial CENTER one horizontal grouping with offered FOUR face-up cards on LEFT, fixed EIGHT face-up cards on RIGHT, twelve total. Visually group and label "提示マーケット · あなた" and "固定マーケット". Offered costs 2,3,4,6. Fixed costs 1,2,2,3,3,4,5,6. Fixed stock badges ×3 ×2 ×3 ×1 ×3 ×2 ×3 ×3. NO stock on offered cards. "更新 1" attached physically to offered header on LEFT; no refresh control near fixed. One discrete watch dot on one fixed card. End-turn control is outside the market card span, far right; must not hide the eighth fixed card. All twelve market cards always simultaneously visible and similarly sized; no tabs, pagination or side markets. These cards are borrowed from Biblion with MANA and go to SHELF; no coins or prices in money.
NPCs: each of these two markets has a separate quiet small presence at its outer header edge or behind its display: two DIFFERENT unidentifiable generic robed semi-silhouettes, no names, no biography, no symbols implying origin, no extra dialogue/action buttons. Their appearance is exploratory only. They are distinct from the two Seeker portraits and never look like player three/four. Keep NPCs tiny and peripheral enough that twelve cards remain main focus.

EXACT COMPARABLE MIDGAME: your 精神力 32/40, マナ 6/8; opponent 精神力 28/45, マナ 3/7. Numeric Spirit shown with each portrait, no heart/blood/flame HP icon; spiritual focus is an elegant restrained arc around portrait. Mana shown as ONE small installed Attune device (faceted blue crystal in a silver/white fixture) with current/max number per player, not 30 scattered gems. No hero skill button. Five own hand cards, including one blue Attune crystal and one treasure chest; four enemy card BACKS at top near enemy portrait with count 4. Use reference eye-and-compass impression on card sleeves and ONE faint architectural emblem, not huge generated wordmark.
THREE monsters per player, small upright illustrated art tiles or cards. Your stat pairs 4/5,2/3,3/4; opponent 3/4,2/2,4/6. One own monster blue attack-ready edge, one own monster visually spent. Two small support cards per player in separate backrow: ONE concealed trap shown as red/blue face-down CARD (never ribbon/bookmark) and ONE face-up persistent spell with opponent duration 2 / your infinity. Explicit quiet "モンスター 3/7" and "スペル・トラップ 2/7" per player so the two independent capacities of SEVEN are clear. Never seven spells plus seven traps. No extra monster units. Attached tiny keyword/counter strips ONLY on affected cards, one readable "カウンター 1". Cards use illustration and numeric cost/type marks rather than fictional effect sentences. No invented rules text or invented card names needed.
BOTH players each have THREE individually labeled adjacent objects OUTSIDE the field: "デッキ 12" (opponent14) is a neat face-down CARD STACK, NOT a bound book; "シェルフ 5" (opponent6) is a small physical inset SHELF holding used cards; "リフト 1" (opponent2) is a precise thin blue-white circular magic formula holding a card, NOT a jagged tear or black hole. Clear explicit Japanese labels and counts; all three are browse affordances, no extra action buttons.
Each player has a compact synergy indicator "シナジー 2 · ✓2 · 3", ordinary type/tribe information, no XP gauge. "ターン 8 · あなたのターン" and "エンドターン" + 38 seconds. Small utility access labels "デュエル記録", "サウンド", "ガイド", "リタイア" around quiet screen edge; their icons look engraved into stone/metal. No fake menu grids.
Contextual existing features (card detail, borrow confirmation with mana price, targets/cancel, deck/shelf/rift browsers, discard choices, roll-result modals, reconnect, result screen) are kept accessible from corresponding objects, not all open at once. No gamepad/phase bar, shop currency, XP, hero power, attack-all, equipment action, quest, chat, emote or unimplemented charm button.

CANON: This place is ビブリオン. Players are シーカー. Records inside cards can materialize here. No new setting history, named world, operator or NPC identity. UI terms use デッキ / シェルフ / リフト / マナ / アチューン / 精神力 / マーケット. Do NOT use the deprecated names or objects: 万史大書庫, 対読, アーキビスト, 読書灯, 年代記, 忘却の棚, 裂け目, 栞, 回覧車, 閲覧印, 系譜の印. In particular do not depict HP as lamp, deck as chronicle, traps as bookmarks, market as cart, or end turn as wax seal. Nothing is burnt/destroyed to depict Rift.
Prioritize COUNT CORRECTNESS, center-center portrait placement, obvious affordances and beautiful calm functional screen. No poster title, no collage, no surrounding design explanations. Aim for the finish and spatial clarity of leading TCGs without copying their visual trade dress.

concepts.title: 白亜のデュエルテーブル
concepts.direction: VARIANT 1 — THE REFERENCE ROUND MARBLE TABLE, competitive clarity. Strict near-top-down view of one broad pale circular marble dueling table, its round edge only subtly visible at screen margins. Very restrained fine gold trim, curved silhouettes, immaculate luminous ivory against reference dark-blue library background. Cards rest directly on stone, soft real contact shadows. Market is a single slim recessed stone card ledge through the table's center, offered4 + fixed8 in one row. Two tiny NPC bust silhouettes at the market header's far outside ends. Spirit/mana portrait clusters are sculpted into the top and bottom table edge at exact x50%. Side pile objects are physically part of the tabletop. No empty slots, only quiet capacity labels. Depth mostly in illustrated cards, extremely clean generous gaps. This is the balanced baseline: easy to play and obviously inside the reference Biblion.

concepts.title: アチューンのインレイ
concepts.direction: VARIANT 2 — INLAID STONE AND CRYSTAL, slightly more integrated than variant1. Same top/bottom/center organization. Calm elongated white marble dueling dais, blue inlaid grooves link the small installed Attune fixtures to their player's numeric mana display ONLY; no new resource tracks. All utility labels and end-turn38 read as flush ivory/blue mechanical touch inlays in the table, not floating rectangles. Market cards sit in two adjacent shallow inset racks centered across the dais, offered4 left + fixed8 right. Their NPCs appear as two tiny resting presences behind each rack; no ornate clothes or new lore. Barely-visible blue/red corner marks show where units can land; no full empty-slot grid. Soft blue refraction under cards, matte white space around them, understated engraved gold eye motif far at the edge. This variation emphasizes objects responding to touch, beautiful material state changes, and intuitive embedded controls.

concepts.title: マーケットのカードケース
concepts.direction: VARIANT 3 — OPEN CARD CASES, tactile browsing. Same exact mandatory centered portraits and horizontal markets, same marble/dark-blue reference room. Central markets are TWO adjoining shallow open WHITE CARD STORAGE CASES with delicate metal hinges (not books, not parchment, not pages): small offered case with4 cards on left, longer fixed case with8 cards on right. Cases have low blue fabric lining, tiny physical stock tabs and restrained small NPC silhouettes behind the case lids. All twelve cards face viewer. Case lids are low, never obscure enemy field. Rest of board is unframed luminous white marble, large illustrated playing cards above and below center. Deck remains literal card stack, Shelf a recessed shelf, Rift a circular thin formula. End turn is an ivory key-like button integrated in right table edge, not wax. Warmer neutral ivory and soft gold than variants1/2, same blue ambient light. Richness through believable carefully made objects with no decorative props. The difference is touchable collections and clear borrowing affordances.
